metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Vietnam between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Vietnam between August 2016 and February 2018?" We need to: 1. Search for active fire detection data - likely MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire locations (MODIS/006/MCD14DL) or FIRMS data 2. Define geometries for Cambodia and Vietnam 3. Filter by date range: August 2016 to February 2018 4. Count fire detections in each country 5. Compare counts and determine if Cambodia had more Data considerations: - Use MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire locations (MCD14DL) which is a FeatureCollection of fire detections - Count features within each country geometry - Check for empty collections (C1) - Valid zero counts are possible (if no fires detected) Implementation: 1. Use country boundaries from FAO/GAUL or LSIB 2. Filter MCD14DL by date and bounds 3. Count features in each country 4. Compare counts Potential issues: - Collection might be empty if no fires detected (valid zero) - Need to handle geometry filtering properly ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define time range and geometries const startDate = '2016-08-01'; const endDate = '2018-02-28'; // Get country boundaries const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0'); const cambodia = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Cambodia')); const vietnam = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Viet Nam')); // 2. Load active fire data (MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire locations) const fires = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); // Check if collection has data const firesCount = fires.size().getInfo(); if (firesCount === 0) { console.log(`Total fires in period: ${firesCount}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Count fires in each country const cambodiaFires = fires.filterBounds(cambodia); const vietnamFires = fires.filterBounds(vietnam); const cambodiaCount = cambodiaFires.size().getInfo(); const vietnamCount = vietnamFires.size().getInfo(); // Print concise evidence console.log(`Cambodia fires: ${cambodiaCount}`); console.log(`Vietnam fires: ${vietnamCount}`); console.log(`Period: ${startDate} to ${endDate}`); // 4. Validate and determine answer if (typeof cambodiaCount !== 'number' || typeof vietnamCount !== 'number' || isNaN(cambodiaCount) || isNaN(vietnamCount)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (cambodiaCount > vietnamCount) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
